instructions: Copy this file outside the repo (it will hold your account details), fill every field, set each row's result to pass | fail | pending | waived (waived = an accepted residual risk; say who accepted it and why in notes), then run: python3 scripts/release/promote_build.py device 201 --record <your copy>. Every row must be on the exact TestFlight 1.3.1 (201) binary on a physical iPhone.

rows.check: Installed 1.3.1 (201) from TestFlight on a physical iPhone; device, iOS and date recorded above.
Upgrade from 1.3 (200) keeps the account, pig, Satchel and owned items; What's new shows Bullion's Market once.
Barn button + shows a Market row reading "new here? · buy, sell, swap" until onboarding is done.
Three cards in Bullion's voice say sets are three of a common, two of an uncommon, or a rare on its own; the guided first trade offers a set you hold.
Sell a set at the counter: the confirm shows the price move, the gavel receipt appears, tickles ready go up. Buy one back: the price rises, tickles go down.
The tin whistle trades on its own: the find view says one at a time, and the copy reads "a tin whistle", never "1 tin whistles".
Pin a For sale listing between Bullion's prices: it shows under Your listings with 48 hours; Take down brings the set home.
Bullion's daily shelf shows up to three sets inside his gap; one buy a day per pig (a second says so).
With a second account: a friend-only listing shows as For you, the friend gets the push, the sale lands and the seller gets "Your ... sold" and "Nice selling." when it beat Bullion.
Airplane mode mid-trade: the sheet says it couldn't hear back from Bullion; a retry after reconnecting trades once, not twice.
With the Ghost Sheep here and fancying a find you dug: it pays double. One you bought at the market pays his usual price, and the sheet says bought ones pay the usual price.
A pair of the fancied find, one dug and one bought: the strip shows each price (for example 6 + 3) and the receipt pays what it showed.
Three alike trade up one rarity; the receipt and the Satchel agree.
Tickle loop, bank reconciliation, Snout earning (pre-ship smoke checklist).
Visits, visit cap, friend Barn ownership.
Satchel swaps and gifts on a visit.
Dig and its receipt, exactly-once rewards.
Season Feed / Draw / Pass, claims and navigation.
VoiceOver reads the market's counter rows, board cards, confirm sheets and the Sheep's tiles with the numbers shown on screen.
Large text.
Reduce Motion.
Smallest and largest phone layouts, contrast.
Cold launch, background/resume, offline then reconnect: no silent core failure.
A market push opens the market cold, warm and in the foreground.
Production Sentry release com.broeking.ttp@1.3.1+201: no unexplained errors; symbols uploaded.
Owner decision on the pre-existing quality:check debt (138 clamps > 91; six older security findings), unchanged by the market.
